# Third-party notices

## slider-resident (adapted, MIT)

`frontend/scenes/home.html` adapts the palette/lighting model, pixel-room art
direction, puppet-pose actor and the WebGL2 lens shader (SDF rounded-box
refraction, chromatic aberration, studio reflections) from
[slider-resident](https://ludion.ai/p/slider-resident) by @Lattice_Node,
licensed under the MIT License.

The two-axis pad (X = volume, Y = brightness), the room layout, threshold
effects and the Control bridge integration are original to this project.
